description: This file contains unit tests for various components in the OpenClaw project, including helper functions, shell commands, network port management, file handling for Canvas scheme, and UI components like menu injectors and window helpers.

classes.name: LowCoverageHelperTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for helper functions, shell execution, network port management, file handling, and UI components within the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: `any codable helper accessors`
methods.description: Tests accessors for OpenClawProtocol.AnyCodable for various payload types.

methods.name: `attributed string strips foreground color`
methods.description: Tests a method to strip foreground color attribute from attributed strings.

methods.name: `view metrics reduce width`
methods.description: Tests the reduction of view width calculations.

methods.name: `shell executor handles empty command`
methods.description: Tests ShellExecutor's response to empty command input.

methods.name: `shell executor runs command`
methods.description: Tests ShellExecutor's ability to run a simple command.

methods.name: `shell executor drains stdout and stderr`
methods.description: Tests that ShellExecutor correctly captures output streams.

methods.name: `node info codable round trip`
methods.description: Verifies encoding and decoding of NodeInfo for JSON serialization.

methods.name: `port guardian parses listeners and builds reports`
methods.description: Tests parsing network listeners and producing port usage reports.

methods.description: Verifies that remote mode port checks don't erroneously target Docker processes.

methods.name: `port guardian local mode still rejects unexpected`
methods.description: Ensures local mode rejects unexpected processes.

methods.name: `port guardian remote mode report accepts any listener`
methods.description: Tests that remote mode listens to all expected listeners without flagging offenders.

methods.name: `canvas scheme handler resolves files and errors`

methods.name: `canvas scheme handler blocks symlink escapes`

methods.name: `menu context card injector inserts and finds index`
